dynamics.qualification: Two seeds per sequence when complete; descriptive short nonconverged stress tests. No p values from correlated frames; no folding/free-energy/binding inference. Native and designed loop lengths differ. Shared-parent-site comparison does not evaluate the newly rebuilt residues. Endpoint fixed-target overlays are not binding trajectories.

glycan_flexibility.qualification: Resolved glycan atoms only. Unweighted small torsion grid, not thermal populations or glycan binding free energies. Reference receptor is fixed. Clash-free grid points do not prove access, and a clash-prone grid does not establish complete blockade. Unresolved glycans/branches and induced fit are not modeled.

required_biological_properties: human binding at6.5 and no detectable binding at7.4
rules.zero_shot: No initial experimentally known binder seed. Common antibody/nanobody frameworks encouraged; our original antigen-binding loops deleted, new loops independently built. Own untested design refinements are not known-binder redesigns.
rules.novelty: Local CDRH3 edit-identity<70% screening plus whole-chain BLAST. Modern organizer classifier/numbering and exact patent snapshots not reproduced.
rules.names: Unique opaque public codenames; no instructions or prompt-injection in names or metadata. Codenames do not make sequences or methods confidential.
rules.registration_and_personal_eligibility: Submitting human must complete required registration and eligibility/rights/consent attestations. Not inferred from files. No automated account submission.
rules.open_track_tools: Claude optional; modern assistant and user-authorized language/library implementations disclosed. No modern scientific protein generator/predictor used.
rules.license: Submitted associated data and tested results can be public; user controls manual upload. Locally retained inputs keep source provenance.
rules.safety_screening: Organizer sequence screening before synthesis is independent of local sequence/format checks.
rules.discrepancy_handling: Main page and terms mention different expected Track1 testing allocations than FAQ; not material to Track3 cap. Use challenge-specific cap20 and no guaranteed Track3 testing.

limitations: No experimental affinity, mouse binding or neutral-pH nondetection established.
Binding proxies omit entropy and full receptor/glycan/solvent/conformational ensembles.
Protonation scenarios are assumed priors, not predicted pKas or independent experiments.
Two 20-ps trajectories per sequence are not a folding benchmark or statistically established stabilization.
Current chemistry improvements are compared with matched C00003-derived B00000; not a global comparison with every prior lead, including C00009.
Local antibody numbering/search is not the official novelty classifier.
